item.title: 2026-11-28 — Wall Street books its best week in years, hackers breach US Air Force cloud, Forest beat Chelsea
item.description:
US stocks capped a powerful rebound week led by AI and chip names, with the FTSE 100 and Europe also higher. Reuters reports the US pushed Iraq and Venezuela to consider leaving OPEC ahead of Sunday's OPEC plus meeting, while EU leaders failed to agree a 45 billion euro Ukraine loan. In cyber, the US Air Force's Cloud One platform has reportedly been breached, SAP confirms a GitHub-related incident and a Drupal installer flaw is under attack. In sport, Nottingham Forest beat Chelsea 3-2 and Ireland beat Australia 38-14.

item.title: 2026-11-27 — Europe rallies as tariff fears ease and Altria eyes Imperial Brands, EU summit stalls on Ukraine loan, Eagles stun Cowboys
item.description:
The FTSE 100 jumped 1.75 per cent and the Stoxx 600 1.8 per cent as Washington signalled new tariffs would be capped at existing deal levels, Imperial Brands soared 13 per cent on Altria bid interest, and Asian chip stocks extended their rebound ahead of a half-day Black Friday session on Wall Street. EU leaders failed to agree a 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine or the next seven-year budget, Zelensky warned of a major Russian attack on the power grid, and Houthi missiles were fired at Riyadh. In cyber, five Mitel MiCollab flaws exploited as zero-days, 1Password customer data stolen via a hacked GitHub account, and FinCEN systems offline. In sport, wins for Palace, Bournemouth and Brighton in Europe, and a record Thanksgiving collapse for Dallas.
